facts.fact: The e-Government Agency issued version 1.0 of the e-Government Interoperability Framework - Standards and Technical Guidelines (eGA/EXT/GIF/001) in February 2016, setting nine technical standards areas for government systems to exchange data: interconnection, data integration (character encoding, data exchange formats, data modelling language), access, collaboration, application design and development, application integration, system standards, metadata and security.

note: Excerpt ends before section 3 (implementation, review and enforcement); nothing on compulsion by law or on checking is stated in the captured text.
